description:
The hidden photo is scrambled into strips—do your eyes catch what belongs together?

You know that feeling when the answer is right there, but one tiny slice looks off.

In this casual montage puzzle, each stage gives you a prompt and a shuffled set of horizontal photo strips. Line up every strip to complete the correct outfit and clear the stage.

・Read the prompt
・Spin each horizontal reel
・Choose the strips that match the target look
・Complete the full photo to finish the stage

It's simple to start, but the small details make each puzzle satisfying. Even a near miss helps you spot what to adjust next time.

Take a quick break, trust your eyes, and see if you can put the secret photo back together.

Playable with buttons or touch controls.
